baslik: The Airship Crash That Made America Switch to Helium

kaynaklar.wikimedia: Italian airship Roma over Norfolk VA 1922.jpg

sahneler.metin: An army airship crashed into power lines in Norfolk, Virginia.
It exploded in flames, and thirty four men died.
The ship lost control and descended.
It was the deadliest US airship accident at the time.
America then stopped filling its airships with hydrogen.

aciklama:
Roma airship hit power lines and exploded. The cause: loss of control leading to contact with high-voltage lines, igniting its hydrogen.

#shorts #engineering #aviation
